prayers.introductionTitle: O God, come to my assistance
prayers.introduction:
O God, come to my assistance.
**O Lord, make haste to help me.**
prayers.conditorAlme:
Creator of the stars of night,
thy people's everlasting light,
O Christ, redeemer of us all,
we pray thee, hear us when we call.
prayers.teLucisAnte:
Before the ending of the day,
Creator of the world, we pray
that with thy wonted favour thou
wouldst be our guard and keeper now.
prayers.psalm4:
When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me:
when I was in distress, thou hast enlarged me.
prayers.antiphonMiserere: Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
prayers.psalm91:
He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High,
shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.
prayers.antiphonScapulis: He will overshadow thee with his shoulders.
prayers.readingYearOne:
Watch ye therefore, because ye know not what hour your Lord will come.

— Mt. 24:42 (Douay-Rheims)
prayers.readingYearTwo:
Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about.

— 1 Pt. 5:8 (Douay-Rheims)
prayers.magnificat:
My soul doth magnify the Lord:
and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

— Luke 1:46–47 (Douay-Rheims)
prayers.examination: Brethren, let us examine our consciences.
prayers.nuncDimittis:
Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord,
according to thy word in peace.

— Luke 2:29 (Douay-Rheims)
prayers.salvaNos: Save us, O Lord, while we are awake, and protect us while we sleep.
prayers.collectNight:
Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling,
and drive far from it all snares of the enemy. Amen.
prayers.collectAdvent: Stir up thy power, O Lord, and come. Amen.
prayers.collectNativity:
Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God,
that the new birth in the flesh of thine only-begotten Son may set us free. Amen.
prayers.collectSolemnity: O God, who on this day hast taught the hearts of the faithful. Amen.
